title: Discovery descriptor v1
description: Per-application discovery descriptor published to callout_apps_{slug}_discovery (ADR 0012, ADR 0013). Secret-free. See docs/design/09-schemas-and-versioning.md #2.

schemaVersion.description: Schema major version. Consumers reject unknown majors.

identityPropagation.description: Identity propagation state and, when enabled, the discoverable bucket/header/kid facts.

header.description: Message header name carrying the identity assertion. Present when enabled.

oidcTokenBucket.description: Physical OIDC token-store bucket name (ADR 0013). Present when enabled.

assertionBucket.description: Physical assertions bucket name (ADR 0013). Present when enabled.

assertionKeysBucket.description: Physical assertion-keys bucket name (ADR 0013). Present when enabled.

currentKid.description: The active assertion signing key's kid (ADR 0014). Present when enabled.
